reviews.name: Arindam
reviews.text: Good product overall. If you don't have a longer usb jack like me you have to buy one because the jack is kinda short and if you are planning to place it where already a electric bord and a adapter exists you can definitely buy it. I tried to make a video but mesho has some kind of error to upload it
The product is good at its price....... But the light i got.... Is multi colour..... It does not have the sunset effect....

reviews.name: Divya
reviews.text: It is a very good product and there are different types of colors in light. According to the price it's very useful and you can buy without a single thought. And also I've read some comments saying that the remote is not working. After receiving the product I also think the same but there's a thin plastic sheet inserted in the remote, you need to remove that for use. That sheet is inserted to provide a long battery life to the remote.
